prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Original photorealistic artistic interpretation of Basilica of Santa Maria la Real, Covadonga, Spain. Eye-level public esplanade frontal view, slightly to left of center, twin-tower facade and small amount of right nave visible. Faithful neo-Romanesque pink limestone building: two equal square slender bell towers flanking central facade; round clock faces below paired arched louvered belfry openings; very tall dark narrow pyramid spires with tiny corner pinnacles and crosses. Lower central triangular gable with stepped group of five tall narrow round-headed windows, balustrade under windows; three rounded entrance archways at bottom. No Gothic rose window or invented giant dome. Entire basilica facade and tower tips fit in middle38% of wide16:9 scene; generous black sky above, broad dry stone esplanade below, modest clipped planting beds to edges and steep wooded mountain silhouette behind. True Night23September2026 23:29Europe/Madrid. Open-Meteo model valid23:15:16.4C,clear0%cloud,no precipitation,wind3.1km/h. Sun elevation-33.38 degrees below northwestern horizon. No twilight glow, moon or stars. Restrained warm exterior lighting as in historical photographs, not garish orange, upper belfry arches slightly brighter; current switch-on schedule unverified. No Christmas lights, no seasonal tree, no spotlit cross projection, no wet paving, no people or statues as focal point. Original photorealistic artistic rendering, not copy of photograph. No text, logos, signature or watermark; lower20% quiet plaza reserved for captions.
